default.en: Tithi not classified — treated as neutral.

meta.note: tithi_index 0-14 = Shukla Pratipada..Purnima, 15-29 = Krishna Pratipada..Amavasya. Krishna rows score lower than their Shukla counterparts because the waning Moon is kshaya-kara (diminishing) for a samskara whose aim is growth; this is how paksha enters the score, so there is no separate paksha component.

translations.en: Shukla Pratipada — a Nanda tithi, but the Moon is still very close to the Sun and weak.
translations.hi: शुक्ल प्रतिपदा — नन्दा तिथि, किन्तु चन्द्र सूर्य के अति निकट व दुर्बल।

rules.interpretation: Nanda class (1/6/11) is generally auspicious, yet on Pratipada the Moon has barely separated from the Sun, so its bala is minimal.

translations.en: Shukla Dwitiya — Bhadra class, growth-giving and accepted for Garbhadhana.
translations.hi: शुक्ल द्वितीया — भद्रा वर्ग, वृद्धिकारक व गर्भाधान हेतु ग्राह्य।

rules.interpretation: Bhadra tithis (2/7/12) support undertakings meant to prosper. The waxing Moon reinforces the samskara's intent.

translations.en: Shukla Tritiya — Jaya class, favourable.
translations.hi: शुक्ल तृतीया — जया वर्ग, अनुकूल।

rules.interpretation: Jaya tithis (3/8/13) grant success to what is begun. Widely used for auspicious samskaras.

translations.en: Shukla Chaturthi — Rikta ('empty') tithi; work begun bears no fruit.
translations.hi: शुक्ल चतुर्थी — रिक्ता तिथि; आरम्भ किया कार्य निष्फल।

rules.interpretation: Rikta tithis 4/9/14 are rejected for all auspicious beginnings. For Garbhadhana the 'empty' quality is read literally as barrenness of result.

exceptions.note: A dhruva/sthira nakshatra partly mitigates a Rikta tithi.

translations.en: Shukla Panchami — Purna class, complete and fruitful.
translations.hi: शुक्ल पंचमी — पूर्णा वर्ग, पूर्णता व फलदायी।

rules.interpretation: Purna tithis (5/10/15) signify completion. Panchami with a waxing Moon is among the best tithis for Garbhadhana.

translations.en: Shukla Shashthi — Nanda class, acceptable.
translations.hi: शुक्ल षष्ठी — नन्दा वर्ग, ग्राह्य।

rules.interpretation: Nanda ('joy') tithi. Serviceable though not among the first choices.

translations.en: Shukla Saptami — Bhadra class, growth-giving.
translations.hi: शुक्ल सप्तमी — भद्रा वर्ग, वृद्धिकारक।

rules.interpretation: Bhadra tithi with a strong waxing Moon — a standard choice for samskaras.

translations.en: Shukla Ashtami — a Parva day; conjugal union is enjoined to be avoided.
translations.hi: शुक्ल अष्टमी — पर्व तिथि; सहवास वर्जित।

rules.interpretation: The Smriti Parva days (Ashtami, Chaturdashi, Purnima, Amavasya) carry a brahmacharya injunction. Jaya-class merit does not override the Parva prohibition.

translations.en: Shukla Navami — Rikta tithi, fruitless.
translations.hi: शुक्ल नवमी — रिक्ता तिथि, निष्फल।

rules.interpretation: Rikta class 4/9/14 — rejected for auspicious beginnings.

translations.en: Shukla Dashami — Purna class, complete and auspicious.
translations.hi: शुक्ल दशमी — पूर्णा वर्ग, पूर्ण व शुभ।

rules.interpretation: Purna tithi, Moon well separated from the Sun and strong.

translations.en: Shukla Ekadashi — a fasting and continence day.
translations.hi: शुक्ल एकादशी — व्रत व ब्रह्मचर्य की तिथि।

rules.interpretation: Ekadashi is observed with upavasa and brahmacharya; conjugal union is set aside on both Ekadashis.

translations.en: Shukla Dwadashi — Bhadra class, favourable.
translations.hi: शुक्ल द्वादशी — भद्रा वर्ग, अनुकूल।

rules.interpretation: Bhadra tithi. Note that the Ekadashi fast is broken on Dwadashi morning (parana); the evening is unrestricted.

translations.en: Shukla Trayodashi — Jaya class, favourable.
translations.hi: शुक्ल त्रयोदशी — जया वर्ग, अनुकूल।

rules.interpretation: Jaya tithi; success-giving, and the Moon is near full strength.

translations.en: Shukla Chaturdashi — Rikta and Parva; prohibited.
translations.hi: शुक्ल चतुर्दशी — रिक्ता एवं पर्व; वर्जित।

rules.interpretation: Doubly excluded: Rikta class and a Parva day on which continence is enjoined.

translations.en: Purnima — Parva day; conjugal union prohibited.
translations.hi: पूर्णिमा — पर्व तिथि; सहवास वर्जित।

rules.interpretation: Although Purnima is a Purna tithi and auspicious for many rites, the Parva injunction of brahmacharya applies specifically to Garbhadhana.

translations.en: Krishna Pratipada — waning Moon, diminishing influence.
translations.hi: कृष्ण प्रतिपदा — क्षीयमान चन्द्र, ह्रासकारक।

rules.interpretation: Nanda class, but the krishna paksha Moon is kshaya-kara, contrary to the growth intended by this samskara.

translations.en: Krishna Dwitiya — Bhadra class; acceptable though the Moon wanes.
translations.hi: कृष्ण द्वितीया — भद्रा वर्ग; ग्राह्य, किन्तु चन्द्र क्षीयमान।

rules.interpretation: Bhadra quality survives into krishna paksha but at reduced strength.

translations.en: Krishna Tritiya — Jaya class; usable.
translations.hi: कृष्ण तृतीया — जया वर्ग; उपयोगी।

rules.interpretation: Success-giving Jaya tithi, discounted for the waning Moon.

translations.en: Krishna Chaturthi — Rikta tithi in the waning fortnight.
translations.hi: कृष्ण चतुर्थी — कृष्ण पक्ष की रिक्ता तिथि।

rules.interpretation: Rikta class compounded by the diminishing Moon.

translations.en: Krishna Panchami — Purna class; the best of the waning tithis.
translations.hi: कृष्ण पंचमी — पूर्णा वर्ग; कृष्ण पक्ष की श्रेष्ठ तिथि।

rules.interpretation: Purna quality keeps this usable even with a waning Moon.

translations.en: Krishna Shashthi — Nanda class; middling.
translations.hi: कृष्ण षष्ठी — नन्दा वर्ग; मध्यम।

rules.interpretation: Acceptable but unremarkable.

translations.en: Krishna Saptami — Bhadra class; acceptable.
translations.hi: कृष्ण सप्तमी — भद्रा वर्ग; ग्राह्य।

rules.interpretation: Bhadra tithi, discounted for paksha.

translations.en: Krishna Ashtami — Parva day; union to be avoided.
translations.hi: कृष्ण अष्टमी — पर्व तिथि; सहवास वर्जनीय।

rules.interpretation: Parva injunction as on Shukla Ashtami, with a weak waning Moon in addition.

translations.en: Krishna Navami — Rikta tithi.
translations.hi: कृष्ण नवमी — रिक्ता तिथि।

rules.interpretation: Rikta class in the waning fortnight — among the weakest tithis.

translations.en: Krishna Dashami — Purna class; acceptable.
translations.hi: कृष्ण दशमी — पूर्णा वर्ग; ग्राह्य।

rules.interpretation: Purna tithi, discounted for the waning Moon.

translations.en: Krishna Ekadashi — fasting and continence day.
translations.hi: कृष्ण एकादशी — व्रत व ब्रह्मचर्य की तिथि।

rules.interpretation: Both Ekadashis carry the same upavasa/brahmacharya observance.

translations.en: Krishna Dwadashi — Bhadra class; middling.
translations.hi: कृष्ण द्वादशी — भद्रा वर्ग; मध्यम।

rules.interpretation: Bhadra tithi with a much diminished Moon.

translations.en: Krishna Trayodashi — Jaya class, but the Moon is nearly spent.
translations.hi: कृष्ण त्रयोदशी — जया वर्ग, किन्तु चन्द्र प्रायः क्षीण।

rules.interpretation: Immediately precedes the Chaturdashi/Amavasya Parva; Moon bala is very low.

translations.en: Krishna Chaturdashi — Rikta and Parva; expressly prohibited.
translations.hi: कृष्ण चतुर्दशी — रिक्ता एवं पर्व; स्पष्टत: वर्जित।

rules.interpretation: Named explicitly among the days on which Garbhadhana must not be performed.

translations.en: Amavasya — new Moon; Garbhadhana is prohibited.
translations.hi: अमावस्या — गर्भाधान पूर्णत: वर्जित।

rules.interpretation: The Moon, karaka of the mind and of conception, is wholly without light and conjunct the Sun. The strongest tithi-level prohibition.
